description: See a TikTok ad the way it renders on TikTok: pass adId for an EXISTING ad (the link works for 30 days), or a videoId with displayName and adText to preview a video BEFORE any ad is built (24 hours). TikTok also returns its own fix-it tips per placement (for example a resolution that is too low) — relay them. Read-only, free, spends nothing.

advertiserId.description: TikTok ad account id from list_tiktok_ads_accounts; omit when only one account is shared with this profile

displayName.description: the brand name shown on the ad, 1-40 characters (video preview)

language.description: ENGLISH, CHINESE or JAPANESE; language of the preview

videoId.description: preview a video before building the ad (from upload_tiktok_ads_creative)

name: preview_tiktok_ads_ad
title: Preview a TikTok ad
